# IMPERIA COLD WAR: War Measures v3 (24.11.2026): crimes, evidence, exposure, observers, peacekeepers.
# Generated by E:/HOI4_Mod_Tools/mdcoldwar/development/tools/war_measures/war_measures_build.py; edit the generator.

# State scope, ROOT = the acting country.
COLDWAR_WM_enemy_occupied = {
	is_controlled_by = ROOT
	NOT = { is_owned_by = ROOT }
	OWNER = { has_war_with = ROOT }
}
COLDWAR_WM_home_insurgency = {
	is_owned_and_controlled_by = ROOT
	OR = {
		resistance > 5
		ROOT = { has_civil_war = yes }
	}
}
COLDWAR_WM_war_zone_enemy = {
	CONTROLLER = { has_war_with = ROOT }
	any_neighbor_state = { is_controlled_by = ROOT }
}
# Peacekeepers protect a zone while the sending country has 1 to 3 divisions in it.
COLDWAR_PK_protected = {
	has_state_flag = COLDWAR_PK_zone
	NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_PK_suspended }
	has_variable = COLDWAR_PK_sender
	var:COLDWAR_PK_sender = {
		divisions_in_state = { state = PREV size > 0 }
		NOT = { divisions_in_state = { state = PREV size > 3 } }
	}
}
COLDWAR_WM_can_plunder = {
	COLDWAR_WM_enemy_occupied = yes
	NOT = { COLDWAR_PK_protected = yes }
	NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_WM_cd_plunder }
}
COLDWAR_WM_can_free_fire = {
	OR = { COLDWAR_WM_enemy_occupied = yes COLDWAR_WM_home_insurgency = yes }
	NOT = { COLDWAR_PK_protected = yes }
	NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_WM_cd_free_fire }
}
COLDWAR_WM_can_cordon = {
	OR = { COLDWAR_WM_enemy_occupied = yes COLDWAR_WM_home_insurgency = yes }
	resistance > 19
	NOT = { COLDWAR_PK_protected = yes }
	NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_WM_cd_cordon }
}
COLDWAR_WM_can_sweep = {
	OR = { COLDWAR_WM_enemy_occupied = yes COLDWAR_WM_home_insurgency = yes }
	resistance > 19
	NOT = { COLDWAR_PK_protected = yes }
	NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_WM_cd_sweep }
}
COLDWAR_WM_can_relocation = {
	OR = { COLDWAR_WM_enemy_occupied = yes COLDWAR_WM_home_insurgency = yes }
	resistance > 9
	NOT = { COLDWAR_PK_protected = yes }
	NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_WM_cd_relocation }
}
COLDWAR_WM_can_defoliation = {
	COLDWAR_WM_war_zone_enemy = yes
	NOT = { COLDWAR_PK_protected = yes }
	NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_WM_cd_defoliation }
}
COLDWAR_WM_can_bombing = {
	CONTROLLER = { has_war_with = ROOT }
	ROOT = { has_deployed_air_force_size = { size > 99 } }
	NOT = { COLDWAR_PK_protected = yes }
	NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_WM_cd_bombing }
}
COLDWAR_WM_can_interrogation = {
	OR = { COLDWAR_WM_enemy_occupied = yes COLDWAR_WM_home_insurgency = yes }
	resistance > 19
	NOT = { COLDWAR_PK_protected = yes }
	NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_WM_cd_interrogation }
}
COLDWAR_WM_can_conscription = {
	COLDWAR_WM_enemy_occupied = yes
	NOT = { COLDWAR_PK_protected = yes }
	NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_WM_cd_conscription }
}
COLDWAR_WM_can_shell_pk = {
	has_state_flag = COLDWAR_PK_zone
	NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_PK_suspended }
	OWNER = { has_war_with = ROOT }
	NOT = { var:COLDWAR_PK_sender = { tag = ROOT } }
	NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_WM_cd_shell_pk }
}

# Country scope.
COLDWAR_WM_root_active = {
	is_ai = no
	OR = {
		has_war = yes
		has_civil_war = yes
		has_active_mission = MD_incoming_revolt
	}
}
COLDWAR_WM_dissent_active = {
	is_ai = no
	OR = {
		check_variable = { protest_strength > 29 }
		has_active_mission = MD_incoming_protest_movement
		has_active_mission = MD_incoming_revolt
		has_civil_war = yes
		any_owned_state = { has_state_flag = MD_protests_active@ROOT }
	}
}
# Observers and peacekeepers are a player to player system. The test scenario can switch this off for single player tests.
COLDWAR_OBS_human = {
	OR = {
		is_ai = no
		has_global_flag = COLDWAR_WM_testmode
	}
}
COLDWAR_OBS_host_state_ok = {
	OR = {
		has_war = yes
		has_civil_war = yes
		has_active_mission = MD_incoming_revolt
		has_active_mission = MD_incoming_protest_movement
		check_variable = { protest_strength > 29 }
	}
}
